_comment: Chapter 1 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F05, a rescue behind the orchard gate: the healer (and the shepherd girl's sheep) go home.

text.zh_TW: 舊果園裡，村裡的治療師正替一隻受傷的羊包紮。「里歐？你怎麼進來的——」
text.en: In the old orchard, the village healer is bandaging a hurt sheep. "Leo? How did you get in here—"

label.zh_TW: 「牧羊女給的鑰匙。我們回家吧。」
label.en: "The shepherd girl's key. Let's go home."

text.zh_TW: 治療師：「好孩子。回村後來找我，受傷了我幫你治。」她抱起羊。「這隻也一起帶回去。」
text.en: Healer: "Good boy. Come to me in the village when you're hurt." She picks up the sheep. "This one's coming home too."
